globe.layout: int16 [row][col] row 0 = 90N, col 0 starts at lon 0 east; value = height / stepMeters; stored as deltas along each row; gzip

polar.layout: int16 meters [row][col], south polar stereographic like the field (row 0 = +y); deltas along each row; gzip

polar80.layout: int16 meters [row][col] (LDEM_80S_40M averaged 2x2), south polar stereographic, row 0 = +y; deltas along rows (wrapping int16); gzip
polar80.tileLayout: polar80/ty_tx.bin.gz: rows ty*tile.., cols tx*tile.. of the grid above (last row/column of tiles smaller), same encoding with deltas restarting at each tile's first column

color.layout: equirectangular, left edge = lon -180, NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit (LRO LROC)
